text:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: INCP-321 fired for 'inference-conn-errors' in us-west-2. Impact: elevated 5xx rate on inference gateway. Paging oncall SRE.

paul: I'm on it, triaging. Starting with logs and autoscaler.

sasha: Thanks Paul. Any customer-visible errors?

paul: Yes, a small fraction of requests are 502/504. Metrics show connection spike to embedder pool. Attaching snippet.

paul: ```logs
2026-03-17T10:12:34Z inference-gw ERROR dial tcp 10.12.8.5:9000: connect: connection refused
2026-03-17T10:12:35Z embedder-3 WARN connection reset by peer
```

nora: Looks like embedder-3 had OOMs and restarted. Kubernetes pods showing CrashLoopBackOff.

paul: Scaling embedder pool up 2 nodes as temporary mitigation. @sasha can you watch for err rate drop?

sasha: Watching now. If it doesn't improve in 2 mins will fallback routing to embedder-standby.

carla: Noted. Informing customer success if impact persists. ETA on full fix?

paul: If scaling helps we'll keep warm nodes. For root cause we'll check kernel OOM logs and quantization memory pressure. I'll update in 5.

incidentbot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty: INCP-321 acknowledged by paul.

sasha: 1-min update: error rate dropped from 4.2% to 0.6% after scaling. Rolling monitor.

carla: :thumbsup: I'll draft a short customer note in 10.

paul: Following up: embedder-3 has recovered, no OOMs after bump. Marking as self-healed but will create follow-up ticket for memory tuning.

paul: TICKET-4512 created: 'embedder: investigate OOMs under burst traffic'

sasha: Closing PD page unless it flaps. Thanks team.
